# doc_baseline.txt -- the documentation ratchet: findings of zl lint --docs-all per
# (rule, file). A count may only go DOWN; lower a row as the docs are written, delete it
# at zero. ztestrunner's doc kind enforces it, under --heavy (make ci) only -- it is a
# full-corpus lint pass, too slow for the fast gate.
#
# The codes it counts: L016 an undocumented definition, L024 a doc that only re-says the
# declaration below it, L025 a doc body repeated more than twice in one file (compared
# with the declaration's own words and every width folded out, so a body written once
# per type reads as one body). THE TARGET IS ZERO for every row: a definition always
# carries a doc, and a doc must add something the name and the type cannot -- where
# nothing can be added, the answer is to rename the thing, not to write filler.
#
# L017 (an undocumented parameter) and L018 (an undocumented member: a field, an arm, a
# generic parameter) are advisory and NOT ratcheted. A member or parameter is documented
# when its name and type do not say enough -- the units, a sentinel's meaning, who writes
# it -- and no count can judge that. `zl lint --docs-params --docs-fields` reports them
# for a reader who wants the list.
L025 lib/system/core.z 8
L025 lib/system/system.z 401
L025 lib/system/system/halffloat.z 15
L025 lib/system/system/quadfloat.z 15
L025 lib/system/system/wideint.z 27
L025 lib/system/zast.z 3
L025 src/ztypecheck.z 27
L025 src/ztypes.z 22
